'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Hey there, soldier. My pals are definitely up to something. Soon as you finished off those Scavs last time, they started blowing up my phone. And you know what? Sounds like they're putting on some kind of show over there. Taking bets, making money. Anyway, they want you to thin out the Scavs again, only this time you'll be working on the military base, and you'll have to use Russian-made weapons. Hell if I know what kind of spectacle they're cooking up, but they're offering good money. So, you in?}}

==Objectives==
* Eliminate 12 [[Scavs]] with [[9x39mm]] caliber weapons on [[Reserve]]
* Find 7 [[Lower half-mask]]s [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]]
* Hand over the [[Lower half-mask|items]]

==Rewards==
* +28,000 [[EXP]]
* 275,000 Roubles
** 288,750 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 316,250 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
* 5× [[7.62x39mm PS gzh ammo pack (20 pcs)]]
* Unlocks purchase of [[7.62x39mm PS gzh]] at [[Prapor]] LL3
{{quote|Nailed it, huh? Nice, grab your reward. I bet it's not the last job from my comrades, they really got interested in your Scav extermination.}}
